about: data/queue.md as Write-ChatqBoard (src/alerts.ps1) writes it while the watcher is not listening, golden: the job files, prompt files and state.json of the input in a data/ of its own, data/watcher.lock held open (the watcher runs, so the lanes come from state.json through Get-ChatqBlocks), the clock at now in zone (utcOffsetMinutes east of UTC) and the culture, whose --culture argument (Get-ChatqWatcherLaunch -Native) the answer carries. jobs: queue/j<n>.json each, from id j<n>, seq n, title "chat <n>", provider claude, cwd code\app, rule typed, kind prompt, promptFile p<n>.md, mode default, state queued, createdAt n minutes past 2026-10-14T08:00:00Z, with the other fields over these in order, a null one dropping the field. prompts: queue/<name> each. fills: queue/<file>, unit repeated times. lines: the saved file split at Environment.NewLine, the last one empty, with <<unit*times>> where it has a fill; null where PowerShell wrote no board. A stamp with no zone is UTC to 5.1 and the zone's wall clock to pwsh 7.
